about_the_game:
Every note in this soundtrack was carefully composed using the legendary Roland MT-32, capturing the essence of the classic adventure games that we all hold so dear. Yet, while the music is rooted in the past, I also embraced the benefits of today’s tools to deliver a listening experience that balances vintage warmth with modern clarity.

But what truly made this project unforgettable was the incredible community that joined me on this journey. This soundtrack was composed(almost in its entirety) live on my Twitch channel, where so many of you tuned in, offered your support, and shared in the creative process. I couldn’t have done it without you. Your encouragement, feedback, and enthusiasm fueled every melody, every harmony, and every beat. Together, we created something that goes beyond music—it’s a celebration of a shared love for adventure games and the soundtracks that bring them to life.

So, as you listen, I hope you feel that connection—the sense of community and collaboration that made this game and soundtrack possible. Whether you’re reliving your adventures in Crimson, Ontario or simply enjoying the music on its own.

Thank you for your support and for being a vital part of this journey. Enjoy the music, and may it inspire your own adventures.

Musically,

Dan Policar

NOTE: Soundtrack is available in MP3 and FLAC formats.
